lines.3: 「I've never written a script for the cultural festival before, but I'll be fine.」
lines.4: 「The Princess really is good at everything, you know.」
lines.5: 「Hmph. I admit she's capable, but thinking she can beat me in my own field is arrogance itself.」
lines.7: 「How would you feel if some handsome guy started talking to me and I blushed?」
lines.9: 「That's exactly how I feel right now!」
lines.11: 「Just watch. I'll crush the Princess you used to admire.」
lines.12: 「Then you won't have to blush whenever the Princess teases you.」
lines.13: 「I'll make you all mine, so you'd better be ready.」
lines.18: 「That intensity has me so overwhelmed that all I can do is answer with actions.」
lines.23: For all the fire in her voice, her lips are incredibly sweet.
lines.24: 「Mm... That gave me strength. It works better than peanut butter.」
lines.27: 「Right now, nobody can beat me at writing romance!」
